STAGE: design selection for ideation_3 (single idea)
GOAL: pick one coupling position not covered by rounds 125823 / 212003 / 221240.
READ: the round history text supplied in the task (fork-angle-transport, fork-angular-barycenter, fork-geodesic-rank, radial-curvature-calibration, radial-volume, radius-geodesic, geodesic-margin, shell-transport, successor-cone-contrast, BRANCHCURV-SID, GEO-SHELL-RQ, GEOPFX-SID, GEO_REPAIR, GYRO-TARGET-RQ, KAPPA_BRANCH, LORENTZ_CONE_RQ, SUCC-TAN-RQ, behaviour_anchored_geodesic_charts, cocond-markov-poincare-ot, CURVCELL-SID, SUCCFAN-CURV-RQ).
OBSERVED: prior rounds occupy (a) curved assignment cost (Poincare/OT/Sinkhorn), (b) tangent-space angular transport of forks, (c) radial shell / radius / volume scalars, (d) margins and light cones, (e) per-node or per-branch curvature, (f) behaviour-anchored chart re-centering. Every one was probed INCONCLUSIVE at the math stage and none touched the quantizer's ESTIMATOR (how a code vector is computed from its assigned points).
REASONING: the free design cell is the codebook update rule. If the code is estimated as a behaviour-weighted Frechet/Karcher mean on the Poincare ball, then the behaviour signal (popularity-adjusted transition mass) enters through the weights and the curvature enters through the log/exp maps and the metric factor, in one equation; removing either changes codebook positions and therefore SID assignments. This is cheap (no extra forward pass), has a textbook closed form (weighted Karcher step), and admits a clean 2x2 switch set (w=1 behaviour off; Euclidean mean geometry off).
REJECTED ALTERNATIVES (all too close to prior rounds): successor-diffused Sinkhorn assignment (= cocond-markov-poincare-ot), fork/residual angular transport (= fork-angle-transport, SUCC-TAN-RQ), behaviour-anchored charts (= behaviour_anchored_geodesic_charts), branch-entropy curvature (= KAPPA_BRANCH, BRANCHCURV-SID), light-cone forward-only assignment (= LORENTZ_CONE_RQ), radial shells (= GEO-SHELL-RQ).
OPEN: nothing blocking; final block written next.

STAGE: final answer for ideation_3 (one idea, printed in the response)
SUMMARY: IDEA BFRQ-KARCHER-MASS -- RQ-VAE code vectors are estimated as behaviour-mass-weighted Karcher (Frechet) means on the Poincare ball (c=1), where the behaviour mass is a popularity-adjusted, parameter-free directed-transition centrality computed only from Stage-3 TRAINING sequences. Single coupling equation: m_k <- exp_{m_k}( eta_k * sum_i w(x_i) log_{m_k}(p_i) / sum_i w(x_i) ), w(x_i) = 1 + log1p(mu_tilde(x_i)). Ablations exist in code but are not run: w==1 (behaviour off), Euclidean log/exp+metric (geometry off), full (both on).
CONSTANTS: all derived, none tuned -- c=1 fixed; radial chart p = z/(||z||+tau) with tau = median ||z|| over the 24,556 Stage-2 items; eta_k = 1/(1+N_k) from raw assignment counts; mu_tilde clipped at its data 99th percentile.
COST: 3000 epochs x 24 steps = 72,000 Stage-2 steps; 3 levels x ~1023 items x 64 dims of log-map arithmetic per step, about 0.2 M elementwise ops, <1 ms/step, estimated +1..3 percent Stage-2 wall clock (~2..5 min total); one-off ~1-2 min preprocessing (transition counting + one forward pass for tau); Stage 3 unchanged; no extra epochs, no extra forward/backward.
EVIDENCE: file-less session; the full specification is the response to the user and the prior record holds the design rationale.
OPEN: none.
